metadata.title: जनगणना में आदिवासी धार्मिक पहचान क्यों नहीं? |Why is Adivasi Religious Identity Missing in Census?
metadata.description:
This video explores the growing demand for a separate religious column for Adivasis in India’s upcoming caste census. While caste data is set to be recorded after 90 years, tribal communities are still being placed under the vague “Other” category, erasing their distinct religious identity. From historical context to present-day protests, this report highlights why recognizing Adivasi faiths like Sarna, Gond, Bhil, and Donyi-Polo is essential for justice and representation.
